title: Inner product of joined blocks
statement: For every natural number $n$ and vectors $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the inner product modulo two of the vector formed by concatenating $x$ and $y$ is the dot product of $x$ and $y$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
